title: Cricket jumper folded on a hamper

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. Overhead flat lay: the cream cricket jumper folded square on the lid of a wicker picnic hamper, the navy and scarlet trim at the V-neck crisp, a red leather cricket ball and a folded linen napkin beside it on a cut-grass background. Soft summer shade, straight down at 50mm.
